description.fun: A belligerent war horse that takes whatever it wants by force. The ice mask over its face is 100 times harder than diamond, and it breathes intense cold from its nose and hooves. Glastrier once lorded over the Crown Tundra until Calyrex tamed it with the Reins of Unity, and it has a real soft spot for Iceroot Carrots.
description.guide: An Ice-type Legendary Pokémon from The Crown Tundra and one of Calyrex's two steeds; Calyrex rides it as Ice Rider Calyrex. It may draw on the unicorn, Scotland's national animal.
description.tagline: A war horse in an ice mask harder than diamond
